# Human Minority

Canonical name: Human Minority
Repository name: Human-Minority
Canonical website: https://rud0lforrp.github.io/Human-Minority/
Canonical public repository: https://github.com/Rud0lfoRRP/Human-Minority

Human Minority is a deterministic, source-available verification layer for AI coding agents and agentic coding workflows.

Core rule: Claim is not proof.

Current public status: early development. The public artifact is an EARLY_SOURCE_DROP with an installable and runnable public V1 CLI.

What public V1 does:
- recomputes exact candidate identity from candidate bytes using SHA-256;
- evaluates producer claims and verifier-result envelopes bound to the same candidate;
- requires the declared check IDs and explicit trusted verifier IDs;
- rejects missing, extra, duplicate or mismatched verifier results;
- rejects producer/verifier role collapse for the same verification vertical;
- passes only the exact required result set into canonical acceptance composition;
- provides committed artifact inspection against export-manifest.json;
- includes deterministic JSON/hashing helpers, portable-path and source-identity contracts, bounded repair/scope-policy primitives, provider-neutral credential-reference and observation/freshness contracts, tests and CI.

Important trust limitation: trusted verifier IDs are explicit authority input. Public V1 checks their use and binding but does not cryptographically prove the real-world identity of a verifier.

Artifact integrity limitation: human-minority inspect can establish internal consistency of committed HEAD with the committed export manifest. Self-consistency alone does not establish authenticity of a checkout.

The current public release does not claim to provide:
- secure execution of arbitrary untrusted repositories;
- Docker or WSL confinement as a public product guarantee;
- production agent/provider execution or orchestration;
- operational deployment machinery;
- cryptographic or remote verifier identity attestation;
- autonomous repair execution;
- merge or deployment authority;
- production secret custody;
- bundled AI inference credits;
- stable-production compatibility or support guarantees.

License: PolyForm Perimeter 1.0.1. Human Minority is source-available and is not presented as OSI open source.
Python compatibility target: 3.12-3.14.
Runtime dependencies: Python standard library only.
